name: Document Identification 51
definition: Identification and creation date of a document.

Identification.name: Identification
Identification.definition: Unique identifier of the document (message) assigned by the sender of the document.

CreationDateTime.name: Creation Date Time
CreationDateTime.definition: Date and time at which the document (message) was created by the sender.

CopyDuplicate.name: Copy Duplicate
CopyDuplicate.definition: Specifies if this document is a copy, a duplicate, or a duplicate of a copy.

MessageOriginator.name: Message Originator
MessageOriginator.definition: Party that originated the message, if other than the sender.

MessageRecipient.name: Message Recipient
MessageRecipient.definition: Party that is the final destination of the message, if other than the receiver.
